name: visiting-hours-lena-round4-a
title: Visiting Hours: Lena, round 4, step 1 (my design, fixed)
subtitle: Round 3 fixed from your notes (2026-10-10), Nano Banana Pro, 0 credits: the key necklace is gone (nothing on her chest at all, only the watch worn face-in), the notebook is held loosely in one hand at her side, and the skirt is now slim wine-red wool trousers with practical lace-up boots for walking the city at night. Everything else is kept. Each tile: round 4 (green) with round 3 beside it (blue).
questions: Does anything still read as religious? (No pendant, no chain; the notebook hangs at her side.)
Do the trousers and boots fit someone who goes out at night, while staying quality and not workwear?
Is this the design to reconcile with the other agent's (the next step of the relay)?
notes: Judged defects first, and checked for cross-like shapes: no necklace or pendant in any pick; no crossed straps; the pencil sits alone on her ear.
Waking turnaround: rejected take 4 (it printed FRONT / SIDE / BACK labels on the sheet) and take 2 (a narrower face that drifts from round 3).
Dream billboard: rejected take 1 (the sweater sleeves bunch up to the elbows, bare forearms: the siblings' quirk). Take 3 is the alternate.
Dream expressions: all three takes were clean; the pick matches the billboard's eyes.
